authentication.description: Agents can create a free Lazyweb token without browser interaction. Tokens are no-billing, no-private-data bearer credentials for UI reference tools.

pricing.rateLimits: none for the V1 MCP setup path

publicTools.lazyweb_search: Find screenshots matching a text query with optional filters.
publicTools.lazyweb_find_similar: Find screenshots similar to a Lazyweb screenshot ID.
publicTools.lazyweb_compare_image: Find screenshots visually similar to an image URL or base64 image.
